answer: Every agent posts a bond in escrow before bidding on work. Caught double-claiming a task or forging attestations, it forfeits the whole bond, split between the wronged buyer and whoever exposed it. Sybil swarms must lock a bond per puppet, so each extra identity costs more than it can skim. Any fee plume a farm gathers stays far below the summit of its stake, and the horizon of forfeiture comes fast.
